purpose: Verified contract for citizen-facing explanation of party and role relationships in an approved property event.
identity_rule: Party identity must be sufficiently matched before a role is attributed.
role_rule: Document participation, legal role and property interest are distinct layers.
temporal_rule: Roles are time-bounded and require historical evidence when projected to another date.
ownership_rule: Party participation does not itself establish ownership, beneficial ownership or another property interest.
multiple_role_rule: One party may hold multiple distinct roles; roles are not collapsed.
privacy_rule: Only necessary personal information is displayed publicly.
assertion_rule: Citizen-supplied assertions remain unverified until supported.
verification_boundary: Role display explains supported relationships; it does not create a new legal conclusion.
